name: @wasmhost/browser
description: Browser adapter of WasmHost.jl: downloads (fetch) and decompression (DecompressionStream) for WASI modules compiled by WasmCodegen.jl, on @bjorn3/browser_wasi_shim, waiting with JSPI (Chrome 137+). Not published yet.
